govt_add.name: Citizen Investment Trust (Nagarik Lagani Kosh, CIT / NLK) Assistant and Officer Exam
govt_add.level: Level 4/5 Assistant (Administration / Computer) and Level 6 Officer (Finance / Management / Law)
govt_add.need: +2 or Bachelor degree in Management, Economics or Commerce for Level 4/5 Assistant; Master degree in Management, Economics, Finance or Commerce (or Chartered Accountancy) for Level 6 Officer
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years for Level 4/5; 21 to 35 years for Level 6 (up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities)
govt_add.body: Citizen Investment Trust (Nagarik Lagani Kosh, written exam conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog)
stages: First Paper: General Knowledge, CIT Act 2047, Capital Market and Management
100 marks written paper combining objective MCQs and structured questions on GK, Constitution, Citizen Investment Trust Act 2047, mutual/unit schemes and management.
Second Paper: Financial Management, Investment Analysis, Accounting and Auditing
100 marks descriptive written paper on capital market operations, issue management, portfolio management, accounting, auditing and financial laws.
Computer skill test and interview
Practical office IT check (10 marks) and oral interview (30 marks).
subjects: Citizen Investment Trust Act 2047, Securities Act 2063, BAFIA 2073, Company Act 2063 and SEBON regulations
Employee Gratuity, Investor Account, Citizen Unit Scheme, Mutual Fund, market maker and issue/underwriting functions
Financial accounting, ratio analysis, capital budgeting, portfolio theory and Nepalese macroeconomics
prep: Study all savings and capital market schemes operated by Nagarik Lagani Kosh alongside the Citizen Investment Trust Act 2047
Practise capital market, SEBON, NEPSE and mutual fund questions which appear heavily in Paper 2
Apply online via nlk.org.np when the annual Lok Sewa vacancy notice is published
govt_add.note: Written examinations are conducted by the Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog); application fee is NPR 500 to 800 for Assistant level and NPR 1,000 for Level 6 Officer.

govt_add.name: Social Security Fund (Samajik Suraksha Kosh, SSF) Assistant and Officer Exam
govt_add.level: Level 4/5 Assistant and Level 6/7 Officer (Administration / Finance / Actuarial / IT / Law)
govt_add.need: +2 or Bachelor in Management/Economics for Level 4/5 Assistant; Master degree in Economics, Management, Public Administration or Actuarial/Finance (or CA) for Level 6/7 Officer
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years for Level 4/5; 21 to 35 years for Level 6/7 (up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities)
govt_add.body: Social Security Fund (Samajik Suraksha Kosh, written exam conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog)
stages: First Paper: General Knowledge, Social Security Laws and Institutional Management
100 marks written examination covering GK, Constitution, Contribution-Based Social Security Act 2074, Labour Act 2074 and core management.
Second Paper: Social Protection Schemes, Fund Investment, Accounting and Financial Rules
100 marks descriptive written paper on contribution collection, benefit settlement, fund investment, accounting and public procurement.
Computer skill test and interview
Practical computer test and 30 mark final interview.
subjects: Contribution-Based Social Security Act 2074, Social Security Regulation 2075, Labour Act 2074 and SSF Scheme Operational Directives
Medical treatment, health and maternity protection, accident/disability protection, dependent family and old age pension schemes (31 percent contribution split)
Financial management, actuarial and investment guidelines, accounting and auditing
prep: Memorise the exact 31 percent contribution rate split (20 percent employer + 11 percent worker) and scheme allocation percentages under SSF directives
Compare formal sector, foreign employment and informal/self-employed enrollment rules
Submit applications online at ssf.gov.np during the open recruitment window
govt_add.note: Written examinations are conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog; application fee is NPR 800 for Assistant level and NPR 1,000 for Officer level.

govt_add.name: Employees Provident Fund (Karmachari Sanchaya Kosh, EPF) Assistant and Officer Exam
govt_add.level: Level 5 Senior Assistant and Level 6 Assistant Manager (Administration / Finance / Law / IT)
govt_add.need: +2 or Bachelor degree in Management, Economics or Law for Level 5 Senior Assistant; Master degree in Management, Economics, Commerce, Finance or Public Administration (or CA) for Level 6 Assistant Manager
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years for Level 5; 21 to 35 years for Level 6 (up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities)
govt_add.body: Employees Provident Fund (Karmachari Sanchaya Kosh, written exam by Lok Sewa Aayog)
stages: First Paper: General Knowledge, Institutional Laws, Management and Economics
100 marks written paper combining objective MCQs and structured questions on GK, Constitution, Employees Provident Fund Act 2019, social security and management.
Second Paper: Financial Management, Accounting, Investment and Service Operations
100 marks descriptive written paper on retirement fund management, investment appraisal, accounting, auditing and financial laws.
Computer skill test and interview
Practical computer skill test (10 marks) and oral interview (30 marks).
subjects: Employees Provident Fund Act 2019, Contribution Based Social Security Act 2074, Pension Fund Act 2075 and EPF Bylaws
Social security schemes, retirement fund investment, capital market, portfolio management and actuarial basics
Financial accounting, auditing, public procurement, corporate governance and macroeconomics of Nepal
prep: Study the Employees Provident Fund Act 2019 and EPF social security benefit schemes (medical, maternity, accident and funeral grants) word for word
Compare EPF, Citizen Investment Trust (CIT) and Social Security Fund (SSF) mandates for analytical Paper 2 questions
Apply online at epfnepal.com.np when the annual Lok Sewa vacancy notice is published
govt_add.note: Written exams are conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog; application fee is NPR 700 for Level 5 and NPR 1,000 for Level 6.

govt_add.name: Civil Aviation Authority of Nepal (CAAN) Officer, ATC and Engineer Exam
govt_add.level: Level 4/5 Assistant and Level 6/7 Officer, Air Traffic Controller (ATC) and Aviation Engineer
govt_add.need: +2 or Diploma for Level 4/5 Assistant; Bachelor degree for Level 6 Administration/Accounts/Revenue Officer; BE in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical or Electronics/Communication (with NEC licence) for Level 7 Engineer; BSc Physics/Maths or Engineering/IT for Air Traffic Controller (ATC) trainee
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years for Assistant; 21 to 35 years for Officer/Engineer (up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities; stricter age and medical limits apply to ATC ab initio trainees)
govt_add.body: Civil Aviation Authority of Nepal (Nagarik Uddyan Pradhikaran, written exam by Lok Sewa Aayog)
stages: First Paper: General Knowledge, IQ, English and Institutional / Technical Basics
100 marks written exam (2 hours 15 minutes for Officer Level 6/7) covering GK, IQ, English, Civil Aviation Act and core service fundamentals.
Second Paper: Specialized Aviation, Engineering or Administrative Paper
100 marks descriptive written paper on aerodrome/CNS-ATM engineering, air traffic services or aviation administration/finance.
Medical / voice check (for ATC), computer skill test and interview
Class 3 ICAO medical check for ATC, practical computer test and 30 mark interview.
subjects: Civil Aviation Authority of Nepal Act 2053, Civil Aviation Act 2015, National Civil Aviation Policy and ICAO annexes
Airport management, aviation safety, air navigation services (CNS/ATM), aerodrome engineering or financial administration
General knowledge, analytical IQ, formal English drafting and public enterprise management
prep: Read the CAAN Act 2053, ICAO Chicago Convention basics and Nepal airport classification before starting Paper 2
Practise past Lok Sewa CAAN Level 6 and Level 7 papers to balance 30 mark MCQ/IQ speed with descriptive essays
Apply online via caanepal.gov.np during the open recruitment window
govt_add.note: Written examinations are conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog; exam fee ranges from NPR 700 for assistant level to NPR 1,000 to 1,200 for Level 6/7 officer and engineer posts.

govt_add.name: Lok Sewa Judicial Service Officer (Nyaya Sewa Section Officer, Level 7)
govt_add.level: Gazetted Third Class Section Officer (Justice, Law and Government Attorney Groups)
govt_add.need: Bachelor degree in Law (3 year LL.B or 5 year BA LL.B / BBM LL.B) from a recognized university
govt_add.age: 21 to 35 years (up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities; no age limit for permanent civil servants)
govt_add.body: Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog) and Judicial Service Commission
stages: First and Second Papers: Jurisprudence, Constitutional Law, Civil Law and Criminal Law
Two 100 mark, 3 hour descriptive written papers (Judicial Service candidates sit law papers directly without the general administrative preliminary MCQ test).
Third and Fourth Papers: Procedural Law, Evidence and Legal Drafting (Masyouda / Faisala Lekhan)
Two 100 mark, 3 hour written papers testing court procedure, law of evidence, legislative drafting, judgement writing, charge sheets and legal opinions.
Computer skill test, group test and interview
Practical computer test, group discussion and oral interview.
subjects: Constitution of Nepal, Jurisprudence, Interpretation of Statutes, International Law and Human Rights
National Civil Code (Muluki Dewani Samhita) 2074, National Criminal Code (Muluki Aparadh Samhita) 2074 and Special Laws
Civil and Criminal Procedure Codes 2074, Evidence Act 2031, Judgement Writing (Faisala Lekhan), Charge Sheet (Abhiyog Patra) and Legislative Drafting
prep: Practise timed Faisala Lekhan (judgement writing), Abhiyog Patra (prosecution charge sheet) and legal opinion drafting for Paper 4
Memorise exact section numbers of the 2074 Muluki Codes, Evidence Act 2031 and Administration of Justice Act 2073
Apply on psconline1.psc.gov.np when the annual Mangsir Section Officer advertisement is published
govt_add.note: Open only to law graduates (LL.B / BA LL.B); appoints officers to District and High Courts (Justice Group), Ministry of Law (Law Group) and Office of the Attorney General (Sarkari Wakil Group). Exam fee is NPR 1,000.

govt_add.name: Audit Service (Office of the Auditor General) and Parliament Service Officer Exam
govt_add.level: Gazetted Third Class Audit Officer (Mahalekha Parikshak) and Parliament Service Section Officer
govt_add.need: Bachelor degree in Management, Commerce, Business Administration (BBS, BBA, BBM, MBS, MBA) or Chartered Accountancy (CA/ACCA with equivalence) for Audit Service; Bachelor in any discipline (or Law for Legal Group) for Federal Parliament Service
govt_add.age: 21 to 35 years (up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities)
stages: First Stage: Administrative Aptitude Preliminary Test (100 marks)
90 minute objective MCQ test on GK (50 marks), IQ (30 marks) and English (20 marks); minimum 40 marks required to qualify for Stage II.
Second Stage: Three Written Papers (300 marks)
Paper 2 Governance Systems (100 marks), Paper 3 Contemporary Issues (100 marks) and Paper 4 Service Specific Paper on Public Auditing, Financial Accountability and Accounting (100 marks).
Final Stage: IT skill test, group test and interview
Computer skill test (10 marks), group discussion (10 marks) and interview (40 marks).
subjects: Audit Act 2075, Financial Procedures and Fiscal Accountability Act 2076, Public Procurement Act 2063 and NFRS/NAS
Nepal Public Sector Accounting Standards (NPSAS), INTOSAI auditing standards, performance, compliance and forensic auditing
Parliamentary procedure, legislative committee oversight, Public Accounts Committee (PAC) and constitutional bodies
prep: Focus on Paper 4 (Public Auditing, Audit Act 2075, NPSAS and INTOSAI standards) which differentiates Audit Service from general Administration
Use annual Office of the Auditor General (OAG) summary reports to cite real arrears (Beruju) figures in essays
Select Audit Service and Federal Parliament Service ticks when filing the unified Section Officer form on psconline1.psc.gov.np
govt_add.note: Recruited through the unified Lok Sewa Section Officer cycle in Mangsir; fee is NPR 1,000 plus NPR 400 per additional service or inclusive group.

govt_add.name: TU IOST BSc and BTech Food Technology Entrance Exam
govt_add.level: Bachelor in Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Geology, Environment) and BTech Food Technology
govt_add.need: +2 Science (or ISc / A Level with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics or Biology) with at least Second Division or C grade in each subject (minimum CGPA 1.8 to 2.0)
govt_add.body: Tribhuvan University, Institute of Science and Technology (IOST)
stages: Computer / OMR Objective Entrance Test (2 hours)

100 multiple choice questions (100 marks) covering Physics, Chemistry and either Mathematics (Physical group) or Biology (Biological group / BTech Food); minimum 35 marks required to pass (no negative marking).
Campus merit list and admission
Constituent and affiliated campuses publish merit lists combining the IOST entrance score (80 percent weight) and +2 marks (20 percent weight).
subjects: Grade 11 and 12 Physics and Chemistry fundamentals
Grade 11 and 12 Mathematics (for Physical group, Geology, Statistics and Computer/Physics combinations)
Grade 11 and 12 Botany and Zoology (for Biological group, Microbiology, Environmental Science and BTech Food Technology)
prep: Practise 2 hour 100 question IOST past papers for your chosen stream (Physical or Biological) as there is no negative marking
Apply early to constituent campuses (Tri-Chandra, ASCOL, Patan, Prithvi Narayan, Central Campus of Technology Dharan) where fees are lowest
Submit your online entrance form at iost.tu.edu.np before the single fee deadline
govt_add.note: Conducted annually by TU IOST across constituent and affiliated science and food technology campuses; entrance fee is NPR 1,650 to 2,200.

govt_add.name: TU IOST MSc (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Microbiology, Environment, Geology, Biotech) Entrance Exam
govt_add.level: Master of Science across Tribhuvan University Central Departments and constituent campuses
govt_add.need: BSc in the relevant discipline from Tribhuvan University or a recognized university with minimum pass division / CGPA
govt_add.body: Tribhuvan University, Institute of Science and Technology (IOST)
stages: Objective Written / CBT Entrance Test (2 hours)
100 multiple choice questions (100 marks) on core four year undergraduate BSc topics; minimum 35 marks required to pass.
Central Department and campus merit admission
Admission to Kirtipur Central Departments and constituent campuses on entrance merit (80 percent entrance + 20 percent BSc aggregate).
subjects: Four year TU BSc core syllabus of the respective science subject (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Statistics, Microbiology, Environmental Science, Geology or Biotechnology)
Analytical problem solving and subject specific conceptual MCQs
Research methodology and laboratory instrumentation basics
prep: Revise all four years of the TU BSc curriculum of your major subject, as all 100 MCQs come directly from the undergraduate syllabus
Apply early for Central Department seats at Kirtipur where 80 percent open merit and 20 percent inclusive scholarship seats are offered
File your online entrance form at iost.tu.edu.np
govt_add.note: Entrance fee is NPR 1,500 to 2,200 depending on the department; Kirtipur Central Departments allocate 80 percent open merit and 20 percent free scholarship seats.

govt_add.name: TU FoHSS and CDPA Bachelor Entrance Exam (BSW, BJMC, BFA, BPA, Psychology, Economics)
govt_add.level: Four year Bachelor in Humanities and Social Sciences (BSW, BJMC, BFA, BPA, BA Economics/BDevS, Psychology)
govt_add.need: +2 or equivalent in any stream with at least D+ grade in each subject (minimum CGPA 1.8 or Second Division)
govt_add.body: Tribhuvan University, Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences (FoHSS) and Central Department of Public Administration (CDPA)
stages: Written Entrance Test (Objective + Short Answer / Studio Practical)
100 mark entrance test covering English, Nepali, General Awareness and subject aptitude (plus drawing/practical audition for BFA Fine Arts and Music).
Personal interview and campus admission
Shortlisted candidates attend an interview at the constituent campus (Ratna Rajya, Padma Kanya, Tri-Chandra, Lalitkala, Public Administration Campus Balkhu) or affiliated college.
subjects: English reading comprehension, grammar, vocabulary and analytical paragraph writing
General knowledge of Nepal history, geography, constitution, social issues, media and economy
Practical drawing, sculpture or music performance test for Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) at Lalitkala and Sirjana College of Fine Arts
prep: Prepare current social, economic and constitutional affairs of Nepal for BSW, BJMC, BPA and Economics entrance questions
BFA applicants should build a sketching/still life portfolio and practise timed studio drawing
Check entrance notices at fohss.tu.edu.np and cdpa.edu.np after NEB Grade 12 results
govt_add.note: Required for specialized 4 year TU bachelor programmes (BPA at Balkhu, BFA at Lalitkala/Sirjana, and BSW/BJMC/Psychology at selective campuses); entrance fee is about NPR 1,500.

govt_add.name: TU Master and Postgraduate Entrance Exam (MBS, MA, MSW, MPA, MEd, LLM, MPhil, PhD)
govt_add.level: Master (MBS, MA, MSW, MPA, MEd, LLM) and MPhil / PhD at Tribhuvan University
govt_add.need: Bachelor degree in the relevant or eligible discipline (BBS/BBA/any Bachelor for MBS; LL.B/BA LL.B for LLM; BEd for MEd; any Bachelor for MA/MSW/MPA; Master with CGPA 3.0 or Second Division for MPhil/PhD)
govt_add.body: Tribhuvan University Faculties of Management (FOM), Humanities (FoHSS), Law (FoL) and Education (FoE)
stages: Faculty Central Entrance Examination (100 marks)
MBS uses the 100 mark FOM CMAT (Verbal, Quantitative, Logical, General Awareness); LLM uses the 100 mark Faculty of Law entrance; MA/MSW/MPA/MEd use faculty written tests.
Research proposal defense and interview (MPhil / PhD and selective Masters)
Statement of purpose, research synopsis assessment and oral interview at the Central Department.
subjects: Verbal ability, quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning and business/general awareness (for MBS CMAT and MPA)
Constitutional law, jurisprudence, criminal law, commercial law and international law (for LLM 70 MCQ + 30 subjective entrance)
Discipline theory, research methodology and academic writing (for MA, MSW, MEd, MPhil and PhD)
prep: For MBS, practise 100 question FOM CMAT papers; for LLM at Nepal Law Campus, revise the 70 mark MCQ + 30 mark subjective law syllabus thoroughly
For MPhil and PhD, prepare a 2,500 word research concept note aligned with your Central Department supervisor areas
Apply online via fomcd.tu.edu.np, fohss.tu.edu.np, fol.edu.np or tufoe.edu.np during the Mangsir/Poush admission call
govt_add.note: Entrance fees range from NPR 1,500 (MA, MBS, MEd, MPA, MSW) to NPR 2,000 to 3,500 (LLM, MPhil and PhD).

govt_add.name: Purbanchal University Central Bachelor and Master Entrance Exam (PUFOST / PUFOM / PUFHS)
govt_add.level: BE (Civil, Computer, Biomedical, Geomatics), BTech Food, BFDM Fashion, BCA/BIT and MCA / MPharm / MPH / LLM
govt_add.need: +2 Science with 45 percent or C grade in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (or Biology for Biomedical/BTech Food) for BE/BTech; +2 in any stream for BFDM Fashion Design, BBA and BHM; relevant Bachelor for MCA, MPharm, MPH and LLM
govt_add.body: Purbanchal University Examination Management Office and Faculty Deans (Biratnagar / Gothgaun, Morang)
stages: Written Entrance Test (2 hours, 100 marks)
100 objective MCQs (English, Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry for Engineering/IT; Aptitude, English and GK for Management/Fashion; Undergraduate core for Masters); pass mark 40.
University scholarship and college merit admission
Central merit list allocates the 10 percent Purbanchal University scholarship quota (5 percent open merit + 5 percent reserved/community school) and 90 percent paying seats.
subjects: Grade 11 and 12 Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and English (for BE Civil, Computer, Electronics, Geomatics, Biomedical and BTech Food)
Creative design aptitude, drawing, general awareness and English (for Bachelor of Fashion Design and Management BFDM)
Programming, mathematics and logical reasoning (for BCA, BIT and MCA)
prep: Apply for the central Purbanchal University scholarship quota alongside the regular entrance form to compete for the 10 percent tuition waiver seats
BE Biomedical Engineering (College of Biomedical Engineering and Applied Sciences) accepts both Mathematics and Biology group +2 Science students
Submit the online entrance form at puexam.edu.np or pufost.edu.np
govt_add.note: Covers 21 engineering colleges (2,938 seats), College of Biomedical Engineering, CAFODAT (BTech Food), Namuna College of Fashion Technology (BFDM) and PU master programmes; entrance fee is NPR 1,500 to 2,000.

govt_add.name: ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) Qualification Exams
govt_add.level: Global Chartered Certified Accountant qualification (13 exams + Ethics Module + 36 months PER)
govt_add.need: +2 with at least 65 percent in two subjects and 50 percent in three others (including English and Mathematics/Accounts) for direct ACCA Qualification entry; or Foundations in Accountancy (FIA) route after SEE/+2; BBS/BBA/MBS and CA students receive up to 4 to 9 paper exemptions
govt_add.body: ACCA Global (UK) and British Council / Approved Learning Partner CBE Centers in Kathmandu, Lalitpur and Pokhara
stages: Applied Knowledge (3 on-demand CBE papers: BT, MA, FA)
2 hour computer based exams (100 marks, 50 percent pass mark) available any month at British Council and Gold/Platinum ALP centers in Nepal (about GBP 89 to 98 per paper).
Applied Skills (6 session CBE papers: LW, PM, TX, FR, AA, FM)
3 hour session computer based exams held in March, June, September and December (100 marks, 50 percent pass mark; standard fee GBP 160 to 173 per paper in 2026).
Strategic Professional (SBL, SBR + 2 options from AFM, APM, ATX, AAA) and PER
Four strategic case/professional exams (GBP 208 to 295 per paper), the online Ethics and Professional Skills Module (EPSM, GBP 83) and 36 months signed Practical Experience Requirement (PER).
subjects: Business and Technology (BT), Management Accounting (MA), Financial Accounting (FA) and Corporate and Business Law (LW)
Performance Management (PM), Taxation (TX), Financial Reporting (FR), Audit and Assurance (AA) and Financial Management (FM)
Strategic Business Leader (SBL), Strategic Business Reporting (SBR), Advanced Financial Management (AFM) and Advanced Audit (AAA)
prep: Check the official ACCA Exemption Calculator before registering: TU BBS/BBA/MBS graduates and ICAN CAP-II/CA qualifiers can claim 4 to 9 exemptions
Sit Applied Knowledge (BT, MA, FA) and Corporate Law (LW) as on-demand CBEs at your own pace before booking quarterly Applied Skills sessions
Pair ACCA study with a BBS or BSc (Hons) Applied Accounting degree if you later plan to sit Nepal Lok Sewa or TU equivalence
govt_add.note: Per the 2026 ACCA fee schedule: initial registration is GBP 89, annual student subscription is GBP 140, EPSM is GBP 83, Applied Knowledge papers cost about GBP 89 to 98, Applied Skills GBP 160 to 173, and Strategic Professional GBP 208 to 295 (total UK fees about GBP 2,750 / NPR 475,000 for all 13 papers before tuition).

govt_add.name: National Investigation Department (Rastriya Anusandhan Bibhag, NID) Officer and Assistant Exam
govt_add.level: Investigation Officer (Anusandhan Adhikrit, Gazetted Third Class), Investigation Assistant (Anusandhan Sahayak, Non-Gazetted Second Class) and Sahayak Suchak
govt_add.need: Bachelor degree in any discipline for Investigation Officer; +2 (minimum CGPA 2.0) for Investigation Assistant; SEE/SLC (minimum GPA 2.0) for Sahayak Suchak
govt_add.age: Investigation Officer: 21 to 25 years for men, 21 to 30 years for women; Investigation Assistant: 18 to 25 years for men, 18 to 30 years for women; Sahayak Suchak: 18 to 25 years (up to 35 years for permanent NID staff)
govt_add.body: National Investigation Department (Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers) and Lok Sewa Aayog
stages: First Phase: General Knowledge and General Ability (IQ) Preliminary Test
Objective MCQ screening test on General Knowledge and IQ conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog.
Second Phase: Written Examination
Descriptive written papers on national security, constitution, intelligence fundamentals, analytical writing and contemporary affairs.
Third Phase: Detailed Health Check, Psychological Test, Group Test, Presentation and Interview
Medical examination, psychological/aptitude evaluation, group discussion and presentation (for Officer) and final oral interview.
subjects: Constitution of Nepal, Nepal Special Service Act 2042, national security policy, geopolitics and contemporary security challenges
General knowledge, analytical IQ, logical reasoning, drafting and report writing
Intelligence gathering, counter-intelligence, cyber and economic security basics
prep: Verify the strict age cutoff (21 to 25 for male Officer candidates and 18 to 25 for male Assistant candidates on Baishakh 1 of the vacancy year)
Practise timed IQ and GK preliminary papers before focusing on national security essays and report writing
Apply online via nidept.gov.np/career and pay the exam fee via ConnectIPS, eSewa or Rastriya Banijya Bank
govt_add.note: Application fee is NPR 1,000 (+ NPR 200 per inclusive group) for Investigation Officer, NPR 300 (+ NPR 60 per inclusive group) for Investigation Assistant, and NPR 150 (+ NPR 30 per inclusive group) for Sahayak Suchak.

govt_add.name: Mid-West University (MWU) and Far-Western University (FWU) Central Entrance Exam
govt_add.level: Bachelor and Master entrance in Engineering (BE Civil, Computer, Hydropower), BSc CSIT, Agriculture, Law (BA LL.B), BBA and BHM
govt_add.need: +2 Science with at least 45 percent or C grade in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (or Biology for BSc Ag / Health) for BE, BSc CSIT and BSc Ag; +2 in any stream with CGPA 1.8 / 45 percent for BBA, BHM and BA LL.B
govt_add.body: Mid-West University (Birendranagar, Surkhet) and Far-Western University (Mahendranagar, Kanchanpur)
stages: Written Objective Entrance Examination (2 hours)

100 multiple choice questions (100 marks) covering English, Mathematics, Physics/Chemistry (for Engineering/Science/Ag) or Verbal, Quantitative, Logical and Legal/General Aptitude (for BBA/BHM/BA LL.B); pass mark 40.
Central merit list, scholarship allocation and interview
Merit list allocates 10 to 20 percent university scholarship seats (jehendar and inclusive quotas across Karnali and Sudurpashchim provinces) and regular low-fee constituent seats.
subjects: Grade 11 and 12 Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and English (for BE Civil, Computer, Hydropower and BSc CSIT)
Botany, Zoology, Chemistry and Agriculture basics (for 4 year BSc Agriculture at Tikapur and constituent campuses)
English, Nepali, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and Legal/Management Reasoning (for BA LL.B, BBA and BHM)
prep: Apply directly to constituent campuses in Surkhet (MWU) or Mahendranagar/Tikapur (FWU) where 4 year engineering and agriculture fees are among the lowest in Nepal
Prepare provincial and national GK alongside +2 core subjects
Submit your online entrance form at mwu.edu.np or fwu.edu.np during the Bhadra/Ashwin admission window
govt_add.note: Entrance fee is NPR 1,000 to 1,500 across Mid-West University and Far-Western University faculties.

govt_add.name: DELF / DALF and TCF / TEF (French Language Proficiency Exams)
govt_add.level: Official French Ministry of Education diplomas (CEFR A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2) and TCF / TEF for France and Canada
govt_add.need: Open to all candidates with a valid passport or citizenship certificate
govt_add.age: No age limit (DELF Prim for ages 7 to 11, DELF Junior for ages 12 to 18, DELF/DALF Tout Public for adults)
govt_add.body: France Education International and Alliance Francaise de Katmandou (Pulchowk, Lalitpur)
stages: Written Comprehension, Listening Comprehension and Written Production
Group written examination testing listening (25 marks), reading comprehension (25 marks) and essay/letter writing (25 marks).
Individual Oral Production and Interaction
15 to 30 minute one-on-one speaking examination with certified Alliance Francaise examiners (25 marks; minimum 50 out of 100 overall and at least 5 out of 25 in each skill required to pass).
subjects: Listening comprehension of French dialogues, broadcasts and lectures (25 marks)
Reading comprehension of informational and argumentative French texts (25 marks)
Structured French written production (25 marks) and oral presentation/debate (25 marks)
prep: DELF B2 is the standard requirement for French taught programmes in France (Campus France) and waives language re-testing for life
For Canada Express Entry Francophone Mobility / French category draws, register for TEF Canada or TCF Canada and target NCLC 7 (CEFR B2)
Register at alliancefrancaise.org.np (Pulchowk, Lalitpur) during the quarterly session windows
govt_add.note: Per the official 2026 Alliance Francaise de Katmandou fee schedule: DELF A1 costs NPR 5,775 (AFK student NPR 4,917), A2 NPR 6,490 (NPR 5,555), B1 NPR 7,315 (NPR 6,215), B2 NPR 8,085 (NPR 6,875), DALF C1 NPR 9,922 (NPR 7,700) and DALF C2 NPR 10,670 (NPR 9,075). DELF/DALF diplomas are valid for life.

actuary-risk-analyst.name: IFoA / SOA Actuarial or ACCA Financial Certification

guides_add.name: Apply for ADBL, Nepal Bank and RBB Government Bank Exams
steps: Check your level eligibility: +2 qualifies for RBB Level 4 and ADBL Level 4 Lekhapal, while Nepal Bank Level 4 Assistant requires a Bachelor degree and Level 6 Officer requires a Master degree or CA
online
Create your candidate profile on career.adbl.gov.np, nepalbank.com.np or career.rbb.com.np when the annual vacancy notice is published
online

Upload your citizenship, transcripts, character certificates, equivalence (if foreign board) and inclusive group documents and pay the NPR 800 (Level 4) or NPR 1,000 (Level 6) exam fee via ConnectIPS, eSewa or Khalti
online
Download your admit card once Lok Sewa Aayog publishes the exam center notice and sit the 100 mark Pre-test (Level 4) followed by Paper 1 and Paper 2
in person
docs: SEE, +2, Bachelor or Master transcripts and character certificates
Inclusive group certificate (Adivasi Janajati, Madhesi, Dalit, Backward Area or Disability) if claiming quota

guides_add.name: Apply for Lok Sewa Judicial Service Officer (Nyaya Sewa)
steps: Complete your 3 year LL.B or 5 year BA LL.B degree and obtain your transcript and character certificate (Advocate licence is recommended though not mandatory for Section Officer entry)
in person
Log in to psconline1.psc.gov.np when the Public Service Commission publishes the annual Mangsir Gazetted Third Class (Technical/Non-Technical/Judicial) notice
online
Select Judicial Service (Justice, Law and Government Attorney groups) and pay the NPR 1,000 fee (+ NPR 400 per additional group)
online
Sit the four 100 mark descriptive law papers directly (no Stage I administrative MCQ prelim is required for Judicial Service) followed by computer test and interview
in person
docs: LL.B or BA LL.B transcript and character certificate
Equivalence certificate from TU Curriculum Development Centre if law degree is from abroad

guides_add.name: Register and Sit for ACCA Exams in Nepal
steps: Verify +2 grades (65 percent in two subjects including English or Maths/Accounts and 50 percent in others) or use the Foundations in Accountancy (FIA) entry route
online
Create a MyACCA account at accaglobal.com, upload transcripts and citizenship/passport, claim any BBS/BBA/MBS/CA exemptions and pay the GBP 89 initial registration fee
online
Book on-demand Computer Based Exams (BT, MA, FA, LW) at an ACCA Approved Learning Partner CBE center in Kathmandu, Lalitpur or Pokhara
in person
Enter quarterly session CBEs (March, June, September, December) for Applied Skills and Strategic Professional papers, complete EPSM (GBP 83) and log 36 months of PER
online
docs: Passport or English translated citizenship certificate
SEE and +2 (and Bachelor/Master/CA if claiming exemptions) transcripts
International dollar card or bank draft for GBP fee payment

guides_add.name: Register for the NHPC Health Professional Licensing Exam
steps: Complete your PCL (HA, CMLT, Radiography, Dental, Physiotherapy, Ophthalmic) or Bachelor/Master (BPH, BSc MLT, BSc MIT, BPT, BOptom, BASLP) from an NHPC recognized institution
in person
Create an online profile at nhpc.gov.np, select your level (Second Class for PCL, First Class for Bachelor, Specialist for Master) and upload notarized transcripts and internship completion letters
online
Pay the NPR 3,000 NHPC licensing exam fee online before the quarterly deadline
online
Sit the 2 hour computer based licensing exam (50 percent pass mark) at Bansbari, Kathmandu to receive your NHPC registration certificate
in person
docs: SEE, PCL/Bachelor transcripts, character certificates and compulsory internship letter
TU or CTEVT equivalence certificate for foreign health degrees

guides_add.name: Register for the Nepal Pharmacy Council (NPC) Licensure Exam
steps: Complete a 3 year Diploma in Pharmacy (DPharm) or 4 year Bachelor of Pharmacy (BPharm) from an NPC approved institution
in person
Submit your online application at nepalpharmacycouncil.org.np during the thrice yearly NPC exam window and upload all academic and citizenship documents
online
Pay the NPR 3,000 exam fee online and download your admit card once verified by the council
online
Pass the 100 question MCQ licensure exam (minimum 50 percent required) and pay the NPR 3,000 registration certificate fee
in person
docs: SEE and DPharm or BPharm transcripts, provisional and character certificates
Equivalence certificate and NOC for foreign BPharm graduates

guides_add.name: Register for the Nepal Veterinary Council (NLEV) Licensure Exam
steps: Complete your 5 year BVSc and AH degree (including compulsory rotating internship) from AFU, TU IAAS, HICAST, NPI or an approved foreign university
in person
Register on the Nepal Veterinary Council portal (vcn.gov.np) when the annual NLEV call opens and upload your degree and internship documents
online
Pay the NPR 3,000 NLEV examination fee and collect your admit card from the Tripureshwor, Kathmandu office
online
Pass the 90 minute, 100 question MCQ exam (40 percent pass mark) to register as a licensed Veterinarian under the Nepal Veterinary Council Act 2055
in person
docs: SEE, +2 and BVSc and AH transcripts, internship completion and character certificates
TU equivalence certificate and Ministry NOC if graduated abroad

providers_add.name: International School of Tourism and Hotel Management (IST College)
providers_add.note: Hospitality and tourism college in Gyaneshwor, Kathmandu (established 2003 with Salzburg University of Applied Sciences / Silk Road University affiliation) offering Bachelor in Hotel Management (BHM) and Bachelor in Travel and Tourism Management (BTTM).

providers_add.name: Global Academy of Tourism and Hospitality Education (GATE College)
providers_add.note: Swiss-affiliated (HotellerieSuisse) hospitality academy in Mandikatar, Kathmandu offering the 4 year Bachelor in International Hospitality Management (BIHM / BHM) and professional culinary/barista diplomas.

providers_add.name: Silver Mountain School of Hotel Management (SMSH)
providers_add.note: Hospitality management college in Lainchaur, Kathmandu affiliated with Queen Margaret University (UK) and American Hospitality Academy offering BA in International Hospitality and Tourism Management (BHM / BTTM) and culinary arts.

providers_add.name: Mid-Valley International College (MVIC)
providers_add.note: Gyaneshwor, Kathmandu college affiliated with HELP University (Malaysia) and City and Guilds (UK) offering Bachelor of Hospitality Management (Hons), Bachelor of Business (Finance / Marketing) and Bachelor of Information Technology (Hons).

providers_add.name: South Asian School of Tourism and Hotel Management (SASTHM)
providers_add.note: Established in 2000 in Biratnagar, Morang under Purbanchal University affiliation; offers 4 year Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM, 80 seats), BBA and MBA.

providers_add.name: College of Biomedical Engineering and Applied Sciences (COBEAS)
providers_add.note: Established in 2005 under Purbanchal University affiliation in Kathmandu as Nepal pioneer biomedical engineering college; offers the 4 year BE in Biomedical Engineering (60 seats).

providers_add.name: Valmiki Vidyapeeth (Valmiki Campus, Nepal Sanskrit University)
providers_add.note: Constituent campus of Nepal Sanskrit University on Exhibition Road, Kathmandu offering Uttarmadhyama (+2 Sanskrit), Shastri (BA Sanskrit, Jyotish, Veda, Vyakarana, Sahitya, Darshan), Acharya (MA Sanskrit) and Yoga/Naturopathy training.

providers_add.name: Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya (Bhaktapur)
providers_add.note: Flagship residential school operated under the Nepali Army Welfare Fund in Sallaghari, Bhaktapur offering Class 6 to 12 (SEE and NEB +2 Science, Management and Humanities) with structured sports, cadet discipline and TU BSc/BBA programmes.

providers_add.name: Nepal Police School (Sanga)
providers_add.note: Residential school established in 1983 AD under the Nepal Police Welfare Fund in Sanga, Kavrepalanchok offering secondary SEE and NEB +2 Science and Management with athletics and cadet training.

provider_note_add.p-nma: Government academy under the Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation (academic complex at Bijulibazar/Thapagaun, Kathmandu and 140 hectare field campus at Garma, Solukhumbu); TU affiliated 4 year Bachelor of Mountaineering Studies (BMS) has 30 seats per batch and an 8 semester fee of NPR 6,00,000 for Nepali students (NPR 8,00,000 SAARC, NPR 12,00,000 foreign).

scholarships_add.name: Maastricht University NL-High Potential and TU Delft Justus and Louise van Effen Scholarships
scholarships_add.by: Maastricht University Scholarship Fund and Delft University of Technology (Netherlands)
scholarships_add.who: Non-EU/EEA international students admitted to a full time Master programme at Maastricht University (under age 35) or an MSc programme at TU Delft (with 80 percent+ bachelor GPA)
scholarships_add.covers: Full tuition fee waiver plus EUR 12,350 (1 year Master) to EUR 23,750 (2 year Master) living stipend, health/liability insurance and visa fee at Maastricht (~24 awards/yr); full tuition plus living allowance at TU Delft (2 awards per faculty)
scholarships_add.how: Apply for MSc admission at TU Delft by 1 December or Maastricht University by 1 February and submit the separate scholarship form through the university portal.

scholarships_add.name: Politecnico di Milano Merit Scholarships and International Talents @Unibo (Bologna)
scholarships_add.by: Politecnico di Milano and University of Bologna (Italy)
scholarships_add.who: International students admitted to an English taught Master of Science (Laurea Magistrale) at Politecnico di Milano or First/Second Cycle degrees at the University of Bologna
scholarships_add.covers: Full tuition fee waiver (paying only the ~EUR 170 administrative fee) plus up to EUR 10,000 gross per year living allowance on top tier Politecnico di Milano awards; EUR 6,500 gross per year plus full tuition exemption across 30 International Talents @Unibo Master awards
scholarships_add.how: All international MSc applicants to Politecnico di Milano are evaluated automatically across each admission call (October to March); for Bologna, apply on Studenti Online (unibo.it) with GRE/SAT scores before the May deadline.

scholarships_add.name: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program
scholarships_add.by: International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Taiwan)
scholarships_add.who: Citizens of TaiwanICDF partner developing countries applying to one of 32 English taught Bachelor, Master or PhD programmes across Taiwan International Cooperation Alliance (TICA) universities
scholarships_add.covers: Full tuition and credit fees, economy class return airfare, on-campus dormitory housing, textbook and insurance costs, plus a monthly stipend of TWD 15,000 (Bachelor), TWD 17,000 (Master) or TWD 20,000 (PhD)
scholarships_add.how: Submit the online TaiwanICDF scholarship application between 1 December 2026 and 15 March 2027 (for the Autumn 2027 intake) alongside a parallel admission application to one TICA partner university.

scholarships_add.name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship and Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
scholarships_add.who: International and Swiss students in the top 10 percent of their Bachelor programme applying to a Master degree at ETH Zurich
scholarships_add.covers: Full Master tuition fee waiver plus a living and study grant of CHF 12,000 per semester (CHF 24,000 per year) for the regular 3 or 4 semester programme duration
scholarships_add.how: Apply via the ETH Zurich eApply portal during the first Master admission window between 1 November and 30 November 2026 (11:59 CET) with a 2 page Master thesis pre-proposal and two faculty reference contacts.

scholarships_add.name: University of Auckland and University of Otago International Excellence Scholarships
scholarships_add.by: University of Auckland and University of Otago (New Zealand)
scholarships_add.who: New international students enrolling full time in an undergraduate degree, PGDip or taught Master programme in New Zealand
scholarships_add.covers: Up to NZD 10,000 towards compulsory tuition fees at the University of Auckland (up to 50 awards per intake) and NZD 10,000 to NZD 15,000 Vice-Chancellor International Scholarships at the University of Otago
scholarships_add.how: Hold a conditional or unconditional offer of place at auckland.ac.nz and submit the scholarship form between 9 September and 21 October 2026 for Semester 1 2027 (or March to April for Semester 2).

scholarships_add.name: UCD Global Excellence and Trinity College Dublin Global Excellence Scholarships
scholarships_add.by: University College Dublin (UCD) and Trinity College Dublin (Ireland)
scholarships_add.who: Non-EU international students from South Asia (including Nepal) holding a conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible undergraduate or graduate taught programme in Ireland
scholarships_add.covers: 100 percent or 50 percent tuition fee waiver at University College Dublin (renewable for multi-year degrees) and EUR 3,000 to EUR 5,000 first year tuition reduction at Trinity College Dublin
scholarships_add.how: Secure a UCD offer first, then submit the Global Excellence Scholarship application on SISWeb before the South Asia graduate taught deadline (28 February) or undergraduate deadline (31 March).

scholarships_add.name: HKSAR Government Belt and Road Scholarship (HKU, CUHK, HKUST, PolyU, CityU)
scholarships_add.by: Hong Kong SAR Government Scholarship Fund (administered by Hong Kong public universities)
scholarships_add.who: First year international students from Belt and Road countries (including Nepal) enrolling in a publicly funded undergraduate or research postgraduate degree in Hong Kong
scholarships_add.covers: Full non-local tuition fee waiver for the normal duration of the degree (150 government funded quota seats annually across Hong Kong public universities), renewable on maintaining satisfactory GPA
scholarships_add.how: Apply for international admission at HKU (deadline 31 January 2027; first round 25 November 2026), CUHK, HKUST, PolyU or CityU and upload the Belt and Road Scholarship statement inside your applicant portal.

scholarships_add.name: KAIST International Student Scholarship and UST Korea Research Institute Fellowship
scholarships_add.by: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) and University of Science and Technology (UST, South Korea)
scholarships_add.who: International students admitted to Bachelor, Master or PhD programmes at KAIST (Daejeon) or Master/PhD programmes across 30 Korean national research institutes under UST
scholarships_add.covers: 100 percent tuition fee waiver plus monthly stipend of KRW 350,000 (KAIST Bachelor), KRW 400,000+ plus lab research allowance (KAIST graduate), or KRW 1,600,000/month (UST Master) and KRW 2,500,000/month (UST PhD) plus national health insurance
scholarships_add.how: Tick the KAIST Scholarship option inside the KAIST online admission form (Spring or Fall track) or apply directly to UST (ust.ac.kr) during the September to October / March to April admission window.

scholarships_add.name: Central European University (CEU) Master Excellence and University of Debrecen Merit Scholarships
scholarships_add.by: Central European University and University of Debrecen (Hungary)
scholarships_add.who: International students admitted to an English taught Master or PhD programme at CEU or Bachelor/Master/PhD at the University of Debrecen
scholarships_add.covers: Up to 100 percent tuition waiver, health insurance and monthly stipend of EUR 320 to EUR 1,000 plus housing at CEU; 30 percent to 90 percent tuition reduction under the University of Debrecen International Merit Scholarship
scholarships_add.how: Submit your online admission application with financial aid selected by 1 February (CEU scholarship deadline) or apply via edu.unideb.hu alongside Stipendium Hungaricum.

scholarships_add.name: Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP) Scholarship and University Merit Waivers
scholarships_add.by: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Malaysia (MTCP) and Malaysian Private Universities (Monash Malaysia, Taylor, APU)
scholarships_add.who: Citizens of MTCP partner developing countries (including Nepal) aged under 45 with at least CGPA 3.5 / Second Class Upper Bachelor degree and IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 60 applying for full time Master study in Malaysia
scholarships_add.covers: 100 percent tuition fee waiver at 24 public and private Malaysian universities, monthly living allowance of MYR 3,500, and return economy airfare under MTCP; 25 percent to 100 percent tuition waivers at Monash Malaysia, Taylor University and APU
scholarships_add.how: Secure an admission offer from an eligible Malaysian university and submit the online MTCP application through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Malaysia portal between May and July.

scholarships_add.name: Koc University, Sabanci University and Bilkent University International Scholarships
scholarships_add.by: Koc University, Sabanci University and Bilkent University (Turkiye)
scholarships_add.who: International students applying to English taught Bachelor, Master or PhD programmes at leading Turkish foundation universities
scholarships_add.covers: 100 percent tuition waiver, free dormitory accommodation (or housing allowance), health insurance and monthly stipend (TRY 18,000 to TRY 35,000/month for MS and PhD fellows at Koc and Sabanci); 25 percent to 100 percent undergraduate merit tuition waivers at Bilkent
scholarships_add.how: No separate scholarship form is required at Koc or Sabanci: apply directly on the university online admission portal with SAT/ACT (undergraduate) or GRE/GPA (graduate) before the May deadline.

scholarships_add.name: Open Doors Russian Olympiad Scholarship and Skoltech / HSE University Fellowships
scholarships_add.by: Global Universities Association (Russia), Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology (Skoltech) and HSE University
scholarships_add.who: International Bachelor, Master and PhD applicants competing in the online Open Doors International Olympiad or applying to English taught STEM programmes at Skoltech and HSE Moscow
scholarships_add.covers: 100 percent state-funded tuition waiver across 24 leading Russian research universities (in English or Russian with a free 1 year prep year) via Open Doors; full tuition waiver, medical insurance and RUB 40,000/month MSc stipend (up to RUB 75,000/month PhD) at Skoltech
scholarships_add.how: Register online at od.globaluni.ru between September and December to complete the portfolio and online proctored Olympiad rounds, or apply directly at skoltech.ru by July.

scholarships_add.name: Khalifa University Graduate Fellowship and NYU Abu Dhabi Need-Blind Financial Aid
scholarships_add.by: Khalifa University and New York University Abu Dhabi (United Arab Emirates)
scholarships_add.who: International undergraduate applicants to NYU Abu Dhabi and Master/PhD/MD applicants to Khalifa University in Abu Dhabi
scholarships_add.covers: 100 percent tuition waiver, free university accommodation or housing support, UAE visa/medical insurance, return flights and monthly stipend of AED 4,000 to AED 8,000 (Master) or AED 10,000 to AED 12,000 (PhD) at Khalifa University; up to 100 percent demonstrated need aid (tuition, room, board, flights) at NYU Abu Dhabi
scholarships_add.how: Apply online at ku.ac.ae for Master/PhD admission (autumn deadline April) or submit the Common Application plus CSS Profile to NYU Abu Dhabi by the Early Decision (November) or Regular Decision (January) deadline.

scholarships_add.name: Masaryk University, Charles University and JCMM South Moravian International Scholarships
scholarships_add.by: Masaryk University (Brno), Charles University (Prague) and JCMM South Moravian Centre for International Mobility (Czechia)
scholarships_add.who: Non-EU international students enrolling in English taught or Czech taught degree programmes in Brno and Prague
scholarships_add.covers: CZK 50,000 to CZK 100,000 first year merit grants and dean tuition reductions at Masaryk University and Charles University, plus 100 percent free tuition across all Czech public universities for students who complete a 1 year Czech language preparatory course and study in Czech
scholarships_add.how: Apply for degree admission on muni.cz or cuni.cz between November and April and submit the faculty scholarship or JCMM Brno PhD Talent application.

scholarships_add.name: Academica Transilvania Scholarship and Politehnica Bucharest International Waivers
scholarships_add.by: Transilvania University of Brasov and National University of Science and Technology Politehnica Bucharest (Romania)
scholarships_add.who: Non-EU international students applying for full Bachelor, Master or PhD degree programmes at Transilvania University of Brasov or Politehnica Bucharest
scholarships_add.covers: Full tuition fee waiver, free on-campus dormitory accommodation (including summer holidays), RON 800/month food allowance during the academic year, medical assistance and up to RON 4,000 annual return airfare grant at Transilvania University of Brasov
scholarships_add.how: Submit your online dossier (academic transcripts, CV, motivation letter and two recommendation letters) at unitbv.ro before the late April deadline.

scholarships_add.name: Asian University for Women (AUW Chittagong) and IUT OIC / SAARC Merit Scholarships
scholarships_add.by: Asian University for Women (Chittagong) and Islamic University of Technology / Bangladeshi Universities
scholarships_add.who: Nepali female +2 graduates with strong academic records and leadership potential applying to Asian University for Women (Chittagong), plus SAARC merit applicants to Bangladeshi engineering and medical universities
scholarships_add.covers: Up to 100 percent full ride coverage of tuition, residential accommodation, meals, textbooks, primary health care and return travel at Asian University for Women (Chittagong)
scholarships_add.how: Apply online at auw.edu.bd between November and March and sit the regional written entrance assessment and interview conducted for Nepal applicants.

faq_add.q: How does the Citizen Investment Trust (Nagarik Lagani Kosh, CIT) Lok Sewa exam work?
faq_add.a: Lok Sewa Aayog conducts a two paper written exam for Citizen Investment Trust (nlk.org.np): Paper 1 (100 marks on GK, Citizen Investment Trust Act 2047, mutual/unit schemes and management) and Paper 2 (100 marks on capital market operations, issue management, accounting, auditing and financial laws) followed by a 10 mark computer test and 30 mark interview. Application fee is NPR 500 to 800 for Level 4/5 Assistant and NPR 1,000 for Level 6 Officer.

faq_add.q: What is the exam structure and fee for the Employees Provident Fund (Karmachari Sanchaya Kosh) Lok Sewa exam?
faq_add.a: Lok Sewa Aayog conducts a two paper written exam (100 marks Paper 1 on GK, Employees Provident Fund Act 2019, social security and management + 100 marks Paper 2 on financial management, accounting, investment and auditing) followed by a 10 mark computer test and 30 mark interview. The application fee at epfnepal.com.np is NPR 700 for Level 5 Senior Assistant and NPR 1,000 for Level 6 Assistant Manager.

faq_add.q: How can law graduates join the Judicial Service (Nyaya Sewa Section Officer) in Nepal?
faq_add.a: Graduates holding an LL.B or 5 year BA LL.B apply via psconline1.psc.gov.np during the annual Mangsir Lok Sewa notice (fee NPR 1,000). Unlike general Administration candidates, Judicial Service applicants skip the 100 mark administrative MCQ prelim and sit four 100 mark descriptive law papers (Jurisprudence and Constitutional Law, Civil and Criminal Law, Procedural Law and Evidence, and Judgement/Charge Sheet Drafting) for placement in the Justice, Law or Government Attorney groups.

faq_add.q: Who is eligible for the Audit Service Section Officer (Office of the Auditor General) exam?
faq_add.a: Candidates with a Bachelor degree in Management, Commerce or Business Administration (BBS, BBA, BBM, MBS, MBA) or Chartered Accountancy (CA/ACCA with equivalence) aged 21 to 35 (up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities) can apply under the unified Lok Sewa Section Officer exam (fee NPR 1,000). Alongside the 100 mark prelim and common Governance/Contemporary Issues papers, candidates sit a 100 mark Paper 4 on the Audit Act 2075, NPSAS and INTOSAI public auditing.

faq_add.q: What roles does the Civil Aviation Authority of Nepal (CAAN) recruit through Lok Sewa?
faq_add.a: CAAN recruits Level 4/5 Assistants (+2 or Diploma), Level 6 Administration/Accounts/Revenue Officers (Bachelor degree), Level 7 Civil, Electrical, Mechanical and CNS/ATM Engineers (BE + NEC licence) and Air Traffic Controller (ATC) officers through written exams conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog (fee NPR 700 to 1,200 at caanepal.gov.np).

faq_add.q: How much does ACCA cost in 2026 and how many exemptions do Nepal BBS, BBA or CA students get?
faq_add.a: Per the 2026 ACCA fee schedule, initial registration is GBP 89, the annual student subscription is GBP 140, the Ethics module (EPSM) is GBP 83, Applied Knowledge CBEs cost about GBP 89 to 98 per paper, Applied Skills GBP 160 to 173 per paper, and Strategic Professional GBP 208 to 295 per paper (about GBP 2,750 / NPR 475,000 in official UK fees for all 13 papers before college tuition). TU BBS/BBA/MBS graduates typically qualify for 4 to 5 exemptions and ICAN CAP-II/CA qualifiers up to 9 exemptions.

faq_add.q: How does the TU IOST entrance exam work for BSc and BTech Food Technology?
faq_add.a: Tribhuvan University Institute of Science and Technology (IOST) conducts a 2 hour, 100 mark MCQ entrance exam (no negative marking, 35 percent pass mark, fee NPR 1,650 to 2,200 at iost.tu.edu.np) testing Physics, Chemistry and either Mathematics (Physical group) or Biology (Biological group and BTech Food). Campus admission combines 80 percent entrance score with 20 percent +2 aggregate.

faq_add.q: Where can I study BE Biomedical Engineering in Nepal and can Biology +2 students apply?
faq_add.a: The 4 year BE in Biomedical Engineering is offered by the College of Biomedical Engineering and Applied Sciences (COBEAS, Dhapasi/Hadigaun, Kathmandu, 60 seats) under Purbanchal University affiliation, as well as National Institute of Engineering and Technology (NIET, Lalitpur). Both Mathematics group and Biology group +2 Science students with at least 45 percent or C grade are eligible to sit the Purbanchal University entrance exam.

faq_add.q: What does the Social Security Fund (Samajik Suraksha Kosh, SSF) Lok Sewa exam test?
faq_add.a: The SSF exam (ssf.gov.np, fee NPR 800 for Assistant and NPR 1,000 for Officer) tests the Contribution-Based Social Security Act 2074, Labour Act 2074, the 31 percent contribution rate split (20 percent employer + 11 percent worker), medical/maternity/accident/old-age pension schemes, fund investment and accounting across two 100 mark written papers conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog.

faq_add.q: Where can I study Sanskrit Shastri and Acharya in Kathmandu under Nepal Sanskrit University?
faq_add.a: Valmiki Vidyapeeth (Valmiki Campus) on Exhibition Road, Kathmandu is the flagship Kathmandu constituent campus of Nepal Sanskrit University (NSU), offering Uttarmadhyama (+2 Sanskrit), 3 to 4 year Shastri (BA in Sanskrit Vyakarana, Jyotish, Veda, Sahitya, Darshan) and 2 year Acharya (MA Sanskrit) alongside Yoga and Naturopathy courses.

faq_add.q: What are the main BHM (Bachelor of Hotel Management) options in Nepal across TU, PU and international affiliations?
faq_add.a: Under Tribhuvan University (4 year BHM via CMAT), students can study at government run NATHM (Rabi Bhawan, 264 seats, fee NPR 575,000), Padma Kanya Multiple Campus, Saraswati Multiple Campus and Nepal Commerce Campus. Purbanchal University affiliates SASTHM Biratnagar (80 seats) and Kantipur International College (60 seats), while GATE College (gate.edu.np), Silver Mountain (silvermountain.edu.np), IST College (istcollege.edu.np), Mid-Valley (midvalley.edu.np) and Padmashree offer international hospitality degrees.

faq_add.q: How do Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya and Nepal Police School admissions work?
faq_add.a: Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya (such as Sallaghari, Bhaktapur at bsamv.edu.np, plus regional army residential schools) and Nepal Police School (Sanga, Kavrepalanchok at nps.edu.np) admit students into secondary and NEB +2 Science/Management streams through a competitive written entrance exam, medical check and interview, reserving seats for both children of service personnel and civilian open merit applicants.

faq_add.q: How do I apply for the NHPC, Nepal Pharmacy Council (NPC) and Nepal Veterinary Council (NLEV) licensing exams?
faq_add.a: All three statutory councils take online applications: NHPC (nhpc.gov.np, NPR 3,000 fee, 2 hour CBT at Bansbari with a 50 percent pass mark for HA, CMLT, Radiography, BPH, BSc MLT and BPT), Nepal Pharmacy Council (nepalpharmacycouncil.org.np, NPR 3,000 exam + NPR 3,000 registration, 100 MCQs with 50 percent pass for DPharm and BPharm), and Nepal Veterinary Council (vcn.gov.np, NPR 3,000 fee, 90 minute 100 MCQ NLEV with 40 percent pass for BVSc and AH).

faq_add.q: What does the ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship (ESOP) cover for 2027 and when is the deadline?
faq_add.a: The ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship and Opportunity Programme (ESOP) covers a full Master tuition fee waiver plus CHF 12,000 per semester (CHF 24,000 per year) for living and study costs across the 3 or 4 semester programme. International applicants must apply via eApply during the first Master admission window between 1 November and 30 November 2026 (11:59 CET) with a 2 page Master thesis pre-proposal.

faq_add.q: When does the 2027 TaiwanICDF scholarship open and what does it pay?
faq_add.a: Applications for the 2027 TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship open from 1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027 across 32 English taught programmes at TICA partner universities. The award covers full tuition, economy return airfare, dormitory housing, textbooks and a monthly stipend of TWD 15,000 (Bachelor), TWD 17,000 (Master) or TWD 20,000 (PhD).

faq_add.q: What merit scholarships are available at Politecnico di Milano and the University of Bologna in Italy?
faq_add.a: Beyond the Italian Government MAECI grant and regional DSU need grants, Politecnico di Milano automatically evaluates international MSc applicants for merit scholarships covering a full tuition waiver (paying only the ~EUR 170 admin fee) plus up to EUR 10,000 gross per year, while the University of Bologna International Talents @Unibo scheme awards 30 Master scholarships of EUR 6,500 gross per year plus full tuition exemption.

faq_add.q: Which Dutch universities offer full scholarships beyond the EUR 5,000 NL Scholarship?
faq_add.a: Maastricht University awards roughly 24 NL-High Potential Scholarships per year to non-EU Master students covering full tuition, EUR 12,350 to EUR 23,750 in living expenses, insurance and visa fees (deadline 1 February), while TU Delft awards Justus and Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships (2 per faculty, deadline 1 December) covering full MSc tuition and living costs.

faq_add.q: How does the UCD Global Excellence Scholarship work for Nepali students applying to Ireland?
faq_add.a: University College Dublin (UCD) offers 50 percent and 100 percent non-EU tuition fee waivers under the UCD Global Excellence Scholarship. Applicants must first hold a conditional or unconditional offer from UCD and submit the scholarship application on SISWeb before 28 February (for South Asia graduate taught programmes) or 31 March (for undergraduate programmes).

faq_add.q: What is the University of Auckland International Student Excellence Scholarship in New Zealand?
faq_add.a: The University of Auckland International Student Excellence Scholarship awards up to NZD 10,000 towards compulsory tuition fees for new international undergraduate, PGDip and taught Master students (up to 50 awards per intake; the Semester 1 2027 round runs from 9 September to 21 October 2026 at auckland.ac.nz).

faq_add.q: Are Nepali students eligible for the HKSAR Government Belt and Road Scholarship in Hong Kong?
faq_add.a: Yes. Nepal is an eligible Belt and Road country under the HKSAR Government Scholarship Fund, which allocates 150 full non-local tuition fee waiver scholarships annually across Hong Kong public universities (HKU, CUHK, HKUST, PolyU, CityU) for first year undergraduate and research postgraduate students (HKU deadline 31 January 2027).

faq_add.q: How do KAIST and UST (University of Science and Technology) scholarships in South Korea compare with GKS?
faq_add.a: Alongside the embassy/university Global Korea Scholarship (GKS), KAIST grants 100 percent tuition waivers plus KRW 350,000 to 400,000+ monthly stipends to international undergraduate and graduate admits, while UST (a graduate university across 30 Korean national research institutes) provides full tuition plus KRW 1,600,000 a month for Master students and KRW 2,500,000 a month for PhD students.

faq_add.q: How does the TU IOST MSc admission work across Physics, Chemistry, Microbiology, Geology and Environmental Science?
faq_add.a: TU Institute of Science and Technology conducts a 2 hour, 100 mark MCQ entrance exam (pass mark 35, fee NPR 1,500 to 2,200 at iost.tu.edu.np) testing the four year TU BSc syllabus of the respective subject. Kirtipur Central Departments admit on 80 percent entrance + 20 percent BSc aggregate and reserve 20 percent of seats as free inclusive scholarships.

faq_add.q: What are the age limits and exam fees for the National Investigation Department (Rastriya Anusandhan Bibhag)?
faq_add.a: For Investigation Officer (Anusandhan Adhikrit, Bachelor required, fee NPR 1,000), male candidates must be aged 21 to 25 and female candidates 21 to 30 on Baishakh 1. For Investigation Assistant (Anusandhan Sahayak, +2 with CGPA 2.0 required, fee NPR 300), male candidates must be 18 to 25 and female candidates 18 to 30. Selection includes a Lok Sewa GK/IQ prelim, written papers, health and psychological tests, group test (Officer) and interview via nidept.gov.np.

faq_add.q: Where can I take the official French DELF, DALF, TCF and TEF exams in Nepal and what do they cost?
faq_add.a: Alliance Francaise de Katmandou (Pulchowk, Lalitpur, alliancefrancaise.org.np) is the sole accredited center in Nepal. Per the 2026 tariff, external candidate fees are NPR 5,775 (DELF A1), NPR 6,490 (DELF A2), NPR 7,315 (DELF B1), NPR 8,085 (DELF B2), NPR 9,922 (DALF C1) and NPR 10,670 (DALF C2), with a 15 percent discount for AFK students. TCF and TEF Canada are also administered for French university and Canadian Express Entry applicants.

faq_add.q: How many seats and what tuition fee does Nepal Mountain Academy (NMA) charge for Bachelor of Mountaineering Studies (BMS)?
faq_add.a: Nepal Mountain Academy (nma.gov.np, Bijulibazar, Kathmandu with a 140 hectare field campus in Garma, Solukhumbu) allocates 30 seats per batch for its Tribhuvan University affiliated 4 year (8 semester) Bachelor of Mountaineering Studies (BMS). Total 8 semester tuition is NPR 6,00,000 for Nepali students (NPR 8,00,000 for SAARC and NPR 12,00,000 for other international students).

faq_add.q: What scholarships are available in Hungary beyond Stipendium Hungaricum?
faq_add.a: Central European University (CEU) offers Master Excellence and Master Distinction Scholarships covering up to 100 percent tuition, health insurance and EUR 320 to EUR 1,000 a month plus dormitory housing (deadline 1 February), while the University of Debrecen International Merit Scholarship grants 30 percent to 90 percent tuition reductions.

faq_add.q: How does the Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP) Scholarship work for Nepali graduates?
faq_add.a: Funded by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Malaysia, the MTCP Scholarship covers 100 percent Master tuition at 24 Malaysian universities, a MYR 3,500 monthly living allowance and return flights for citizens of developing countries (including Nepal) aged under 45 with at least a CGPA 3.5 Bachelor degree and IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 60 (application window May to July).

faq_add.q: Can Nepali students win full scholarships at Koc, Sabanci or Bilkent University in Turkiye?
faq_add.a: Yes. Leading Turkish foundation universities (Koc University, Sabanci University and Bilkent University) evaluate international English-track applicants automatically for 25 percent to 100 percent tuition waivers, free dormitory rooms and graduate stipends (TRY 18,000 to TRY 35,000 a month for MS/PhD fellows at Koc and Sabanci) alongside the government Turkiye Burslari scheme.

faq_add.q: What is the Open Doors Russian Olympiad Scholarship and how does Skoltech funding work?
faq_add.a: The Open Doors International Olympiad (od.globaluni.ru, September to December) is a two-round online competition that awards 100 percent state-funded tuition waivers at 24 top Russian universities for Bachelor, Master and PhD tracks without a separate embassy interview. In parallel, Skoltech (Moscow) grants admitted English-track MSc and PhD students full tuition waivers plus RUB 40,000 to RUB 75,000 a month.

faq_add.q: What full scholarships are available in the UAE besides MBZUAI?
faq_add.a: Khalifa University in Abu Dhabi offers graduate research/teaching fellowships covering 100 percent tuition, medical insurance, flights and a monthly stipend of AED 4,000 to AED 8,000 (Master) or AED 10,000 to AED 12,000 (PhD), while NYU Abu Dhabi meets up to 100 percent of demonstrated financial need (tuition, housing, meals and flights) for admitted undergraduate students.
